sketches.mechanism: The Maybe monad's >>= (bind) silently propagates Nothing — once any step yields Nothing, all subsequent steps are skipped without error.
sketches.resonance: After loss, every future action passes through the absence; the chain continues but carries nothing forward.
sketches.draft:
moved_on :: Maybe a
moved_on =
  return ()    -- we begin
  >>= \_ -> Nothing   -- then you left
  >>= \_ -> return ()  -- I kept going
  >>= \_ -> return ()  -- I kept going
  >>= \_ -> return ()  -- I kept going

sketches.mechanism: A generator function with yield but no next() caller — the function body never executes, suspended forever at the start.
sketches.resonance: Everything I wanted to say exists, fully written, but without someone to receive it, none of it ever runs.
sketches.draft:
def everything_i_wanted_to_say():
    yield
    yield
    yield
    yield
    yield

unsent = everything_i_wanted_to_say()

sketches.mechanism: The finally block executes regardless of whether an exception was thrown or caught — it runs no matter what happened.
sketches.resonance: No matter how it ends — gracefully or in catastrophe — some things you carry with you always.
